title: Humility and Faith
reading:
Faith flourishes in humility. The proud heart trusts itself; the humble heart trusts God.

Humility says, "I believe; help my unbelief."
reflection: Where do I struggle to trust? Is self-reliance hindering my faith? What promise must I cling to today?
abide: Faith does not begin with certainty. It begins with coming. You are here. That is enough.
